verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a Registrar API for searching, checking, registering and managing domains, and an OpenAPI spec exists, so API-driven purchase is claimed. Contact editing is documented only generally, not as an API call. Nameservers are fixed to Cloudflare's, which the community confirms, so the nameserver step of the story cannot be scripted. missing for 10: documented API calls for setting registrant contacts, ability to set custom nameservers via API, request/response detail for the purchase endpoint, hands-on corroboration of scripted registration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can register a domain end to end via the API — purchase, contacts, and nameservers in documented calls, so registration can be part of a deploy script

citations.quote: Registrar API for searching, checking, registering, and managing domains through Cloudflare Registrar.
You may edit the WHOIS contact data for any domain.
All domains acquired via Cloudflare Registrar use Cloudflare nameservers
